City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  March 02, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the small Executive Conference
Room on the 9th floor at 11:47 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, City Treasurer
  Ken Campos, Legal

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes- Human Resources
  Craig Civitello – Parks and Recreation

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of February 24, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Royal Plywood Company - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  the purchase of replacement skateboard ramps for the City Parks in the amount of
  $1,921.73. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Integra Realty Resources – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  appraisal of affordable housing development project in the amount of $5,000.00.

  Closed Session- Confidential
  4. Karen Tishkoff vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to recommend
  settlement on claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:03 p.m. Adjournment
